text:
A measured weekend at the desk began with your comments, and we are sincerely sorry for the distress caused when your companion animal travel arrangement did not meet the standard you were promised. You said the handling of your pet's journey felt disorganized, that the information given before departure was unclear, and that the support you received did not reflect the care you expected from Aurelia Skyways.

We take that seriously. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is meant to guide passengers through companion animal travel with steady advice, careful checks, and a welfare first approach. When service falls short, the impact is felt not only by the traveler but also by the animal relying on calm handling and predictable procedures. That is not acceptable, and I am sorry that your experience created worry instead of confidence.

Your report has been reviewed with the welfare coordinator and the desk team so we can trace where communication broke down and where a process should have been followed more clearly. We are also reinforcing the requirement that staff confirm essential travel details in plain language and check comfort needs before a booking is moved forward. This is routine work at our desk, but it must be routine done well, every time.

Please accept our apology for the frustration you encountered. Aurelia Skyways aims for dependable companion travel, and your comments show us where our standards must be applied with more care and consistency. We will use your feedback to improve how we prepare passengers and their animals for travel, and to strengthen the way we respond when a concern is raised.

If you choose to travel with us again, we want the next experience to be calmer, clearer, and fully aligned with the service our desk is meant to provide. We appreciate you taking the time to speak up, because direct reporting helps us correct weaknesses before they affect another traveler or pet. We remain committed to better support and more reliable companion animal care.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
